about: Files of the dual_d1 snapshot that are not in the repository (over the 50 MB file limit). They are hosted in the project's Zenodo data record under a flat name (hosted_name); Record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466766 (files at https://zenodo.org/records/23466766/files/<hosted_name>). make fetch-data places them in <WORK>/hosted/<path>, from which the work copy takes them; replay-full needs them.

files.needed_by: replay-full: reproduce.py --task certificates (complete C7 certificate, weight 6: 141,765,281 expanded terms)
